description: An activity's duration (seconds) as a message: { key: "duration.hm", args: { h, m } } ("3h 52m") from an hour up, { key: "duration.m", args: { m } } ("43m") from a minute, else { key: "duration.s", args: { s } } ("20s"). The keys are the web's catalog; Android maps them to panel_duration_hm, _m and _s.

cases.name: an hour is hours and minutes
hours and minutes drop the seconds
